title: GR180 version E generator joints / fits / seals / fasteners

screws.joint: front end bell E-G230 -> housing E-G200
screws.internal_thread: HELICOIL plus M10 x 1.5D (15) in 6082-T6, blind 22

screws.joint: rear end bell E-G231 -> housing E-G200
screws.internal_thread: HELICOIL plus M10 x 1.5D (15) in 6082-T6, blind 22

screws.joint: front bearing cap E-G232 -> front hub
rear seal cap E-G233 + guard flange E-G235 -> rear hub
air hood E-G234 -> front end bell
screws.internal_thread: HELICOIL plus M6 x 1D (6), through the hood bosses

screws.lock: Nord-Lock; strap preload limits the Al housing stress

screws.internal_thread: through x-slots, nuts inside the RHS
screws.lock: after alignment; jack bolts M16 x / y, shims z

screws.joint: base beam E-G262 -> plenum floor / frame
screws.internal_thread: through floor + doubler, onto the frame cross members x -1050 / -600 / -200

screws.joint: quill hub on the 1:10 shaft taper
screws.internal_thread: M12x1.25 in the 42CrMo4 shaft end, 24 deep
screws.lock: MoS2 paste under the head + on the thread; drive-up 0.6 +/-0.1 mm checked with a dial gauge

screws.joint: bearing inner rings (front 7008-E + speed wheel, rear 7008-C)
screws.screw: precision lock nut M35x1.5 OD 52 B 12 (Spieth MSF 35x1.5 / SKF KMD 7)
screws.lock: 2 radial clamping screws M5, 4 N.m (nut-maker value)

fits.joint: bearing IR on the d40 journals
fits.result: -3.5 .. +9.5 um (light press: heat IR to 80 C)
0 .. 15 um clearance (rear floats on the wave spring; front clamped by the cap)
radial oil film 0.120 .. 0.136 mm (same as the core cartridges)
0.081 .. 0.120 interference; heat screen to 220 C (CuCr1Zr, 20 min)
0.06 .. 0.093 bond gap: Henkel Loctite AA 326 + 7649 activator (or Araldite-free: Loctite EA 9497 high-temp epoxy)
0 .. 43 clearance, Loctite 648 + axial clamp by the sleeve

fits.joint: CFRP sleeve on magnets + end rings
fits.shaft: magnet OD 1:500 taper, ground after bonding
fits.result: diametral interference 0.57 +/-0.02 mm set by the press stroke (eg_sleeve.json)
0.183 .. 0.240 interference; heat jacket to 180 C; 0.08 .. 0.13 left at 60 C

fits.hole: 290 H7 (housing, same setting as the 286 H7)
4 H7 in the hub shoulder; slot 4.2 in the cartridge lip

fits.joint: quill hub on the shaft taper
fits.result: drive-up 0.6 mm -> 0.06 mm diametral interference, T_cap 716 N.m (eg_rotor.json)

fits.joint: quill socket on the core hex
fits.shaft: crowned hex AF 23.990 .. 24.000 (core shaft, gas nitrided)
fits.result: 0.020 .. 0.050 on flats, axial float +/-1 mm, no adjustment
radial 0.30 .. 0.33 mm (SFD orbit + thermal); outer: quill hub d56 h6 in d56.60
centres the guard on the shaft axis (<= 0.1)

orings.seal: jacket O-ring lands (2 per end, leak-off groove 2 x 1 mm between)
SFD cartridges (2 per cartridge, centring spring ~3 N/um, measure)
front bearing cap spigot (radial, in the 84.24 hub bore)
rear seal cap spigot (radial, in the 84.24 hub bore)
glycol fittings G3/4 + leak-off G1/8 (ISO 1179-2 form E)

helicoils.where: hub end faces r 47 (front bearing cap, rear seal cap + guard)

jacking.threads: 2 x M10 in each flange (180 deg apart), push against the housing face
2 x M10 in the jacket front face
jacking.tool: pull bar + 2 x M10 rods, hydraulic cylinder 2 t against the housing face

jacking.threads: M14 x 1.5 in the hub bore behind the bolt seat
jacking.tool: M14 jacking screw through the hollow quill

axial.rotor_axial_position: front 7008-E locates; its cartridge is clamped by the front bearing cap on a ground shim (E-G226, 0.5-2.0 mm) -> magnet centre to stack centre +/-0.3 mm (measured from the rear seal-cap face with a depth gauge)
axial.rear: 7008-C outer ring floats in its cartridge (0..15 um), 300 N wave spring (E-G224) between the cartridge lip and the OR -> preload on both bearings
axial.thermal: rotor grows ~+0.35 mm rearward vs. the housing at full load (steel shaft 85 C vs Al pod 60 C): taken by the floating rear OR and the +/-1 mm quill float
axial.end_float_quill: +/-1.0 mm at the AF24 socket (hex engagement 23 mm)

electrical.creepage: terminal block: >= 12.5 mm creepage, 8 mm clearance (IEC 60664-1, 1000 V, pollution 3)
electrical.insulation: strand enamel grade 2 class 200 + polyimide tape + glass serving per conductor; APA (aramid / polyimide / aramid) 0.31 slot liner (ground wall); APA 0.5 layer separator; aramid paper 0.25 phase separators in the end windings (Metastar CN / Teijin JP); VPI epoxy class H (Elantas Elmotherm / Von Roll Damisol, CH/DE)
electrical.tests: IEC 60034-1: 2 U + 1000 V = 2.3 kV ac 1 min (new winding; 1.0 kV dc IR > 1 GOhm at 40 C); surge 3.5 kV (IEC 60034-15 level for 690 V class)

notes: A4-80 into Al only with HELICOIL plus (Boellhoff DE, 1.4301), tapped with STI taps; k 0.5 keeps the Al bearing stress < 250 MPa under the heads (washer-face heads)
all rotating fasteners (nuts, pull bolt) are balanced with the rotor and angle-marked
